definitions: Even the most submissive or downtrodden person will eventually retaliate or assert themselves if pushed too far.
A situation where someone who has been oppressed or mistreated will eventually fight back or seek revenge.
examples: They've been taking advantage of her for years, but the worm will turn.
He thinks he can push everyone around, but eventually, the worm will turn.
Don't underestimate them; the worm will turn if you keep treating them badly.
